# billing API

Plans, checkout and the Stripe webhook (only with billing enabled).

Base path `/api/v1/billing` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/billing.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/billing.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### billing

#### POST /api/v1/billing/checkout

**Checkout**

Start a hosted checkout for `plan`; redirect the browser to `url`.

422 when the plan is not sold here, 409 when the account already has a subscription (plan changes and cancellation happen in the customer portal).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [CheckoutIn](#checkoutin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [RedirectOut](#redirectout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/invoices

**Invoices**

The newest invoices of the caller's account (links to the provider's pages).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [InvoiceOut](#invoiceout) |

#### POST /api/v1/billing/portal

**Portal**

Open the provider's customer portal (payment method, invoices, plan change, cancel).

404 before the account's first checkout.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [RedirectOut](#redirectout) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/status

**Status**

Billing runs here: the provider, the currency and the plans on sale with prices.

Public (a pricing view needs no login). The web app probes it: a network error or 404 (the service is not deployed, billing is disabled) hides every billing element.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BillingStatusOut](#billingstatusout) |

#### GET /api/v1/billing/subscription

**Subscription**

The subscription of the caller's account (`subscription: null` before checkout).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [SubscriptionSummaryOut](#subscriptionsummaryout) |

#### POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks/stripe

**Stripe Webhook**

Stripe events. No token: only the `Stripe-Signature` over the raw body counts.

400 for an invalid signature, 200 for a handled or repeated event (each event id is processed once), 500 when handling failed (Stripe retries).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stripe-signature` | header | string or null | no |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [WebhookOut](#webhookout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

## Schemas

### BillingStatusOut

`GET /status`: billing runs in this installation and what it sells.

The service only runs when billing is enabled, so a reachable endpoint always says `enabled: true`; the web app treats a network error or 404 as "billing disabled".

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `automatic_tax` | boolean | yes | Stripe Tax calculates VAT in Checkout. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `plans` | array of [StatusPlanOut](#statusplanout) | yes |  |
| `provider` | string | yes |  |

### CheckoutIn

Body of `POST /checkout`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | string | yes | pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$` |

### HTTPValidationError

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detail` | array of [ValidationError](#validationerror) | no |  |

### InvoiceOut

An invoice reference; the document itself stays at the provider.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount_due` | integer | yes | Cents. |
| `amount_paid` | integer | yes | Cents. |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |
| `hosted_url` | string or null | yes |  |
| `issued_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `number` | string or null | yes |  |
| `pdf_url` | string or null | yes |  |
| `status` | string | yes |  |

### PlanStatus

Status of an account's plan.

Type: `"active"` \| `"trial"` \| `"grace"` \| `"expired"`

### PriceOut

A provider price; amounts in the smallest currency unit (cents).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currency` | string or null | yes | ISO 4217, lower case; null when not fetched. |
| `interval` | string or null | yes | day, week, month or year. |
| `interval_count` | integer or null | yes |  |
| `price_id` | string | yes |  |
| `unit_amount` | integer or null | yes | Amount per interval in cents. |

### RedirectOut

A provider page to send the browser to.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | yes |  |

### StatusPlanOut

A plan on sale.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string or null | yes |  |
| `key` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string or null | yes | From Entitlements; null when it is not reachable. |
| `price` | [PriceOut](#priceout) | yes |  |
| `trial_days` | integer | yes | Trial of a first subscription (from Entitlements). |

### SubscriptionOut

A subscription as the provider last reported it.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel_at_period_end` | boolean | yes |  |
| `current_period_end` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `grace_until` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `plan` | string or null | yes |  |
| `plan_status` | [PlanStatus](#planstatus) or null | yes | What Billing set in Entitlements. |
| `status` | [SubscriptionStatus](#subscriptionstatus) | yes |  |
| `trial_end` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |

### SubscriptionStatus

Status of a subscription at the payment provider (Stripe's values).

Type: `"incomplete"` \| `"incomplete_expired"` \| `"trialing"` \| `"active"` \| `"past_due"` \| `"canceled"` \| `"unpaid"` \| `"paused"`

### SubscriptionSummaryOut

`GET /subscription`: the account's subscription (null before the first checkout).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `has_customer` | boolean | yes | The portal can be opened. |
| `provider` | string | yes |  |
| `subscription` | [SubscriptionOut](#subscriptionout) or null | yes |  |
